title: Regulatory Signs, Barricades, and Gates
description: STOP/YIELD and intersection right-of-way control, California speed-limit and E&TS speed-zoning rules, movement/lane control signs, DO NOT ENTER/WRONG WAY/ONE WAY signing, parking and standing/stopping signs, pedestrian and traffic-signal regulatory signs, weight limit and truck signs, barricades and gates, and the California-only R/SR-series signs.
